behavior_summary: A low-beam request moves the controller from LIGHTS_OFF to LOW_BEAM. Automatic high beam is entered only when assist is enabled and a high-beam request is active. If an oncoming vehicle is detected under those conditions, the controller uses HIGH_BEAM_BLOCKED, which keeps the low beam on and the high beam off. Removing the low-beam request turns both outputs off; disabling assist or removing the high-beam request returns an active or blocked high-beam state to LOW_BEAM. When the oncoming-vehicle indication clears, HIGH_BEAM_BLOCKED returns to HIGH_BEAM if the requests and assist enable remain active.
